[05:54] Derek: sometimes i see 'red wood' written in notes, hope that's you — ha. also, do you persist prompts? we need data residency assurances.
[06:08] Jordan: no customer prompts are persisted beyond configured retention for hosted — can set retention to 0 for sensitive flows. for private, you own the data store.

[09:50] Priya: to align — provisioning dedicated nodes in eu-west is usually 2-4 weeks depending on inventory. on-prem pilot plus onboarding is closer to 6-8 weeks; we can fast-path if you agree to a small set of dedicated infra commitments.
[10:06] Sofia: benchmarks — can we run a short token-per-second benchmark on our prompts? we want to know 99th percentile.
[10:16] Priya: yes, we'll schedule benchmark run with your infra team. sample harness is in the docs, but we'll tailor prompt sets.

[13:12] Jordan: on contract, we can do an amendment that adds an annual top-up clause and a prorated charge for mid-term additions. default terms are monthly metered but a reserved pool improves unit economics.
[13:24] Maya: procurement will need language for invoice timing and also termination liability for the pilot.
[13:31] Jordan: we'll include a pilot addendum with a stop clause and a mutual acceptance criteria for the onprem test.

[24:01] Sofia: regarding quantization and cost — can you recommend a profile? we run a lot of short prompts for classification and some long chat sessions.
[24:12] Priya: for mixed workloads we'd suggest 4-bit quantized variants for short prompts and 8-bit for long chat. Redwood Optimize can give tailored batching + cache settings to hit your cost target. we'll share a sample config.

[28:45] Maya: correct. procurement wants exact language and costs.

[40:25] Sofia: thanks, bye.
